title: PISR: A Search-Free Foundation Model for Symbolic Regression of Physical Laws — code, model weights, and data

creators.name: Chen, Jingqiu
creators.affiliation: College of Physics and Optoelectronic Engineering, Shenzhen University

description: Source code, pre-trained model weights, benchmark task sets, per-task baseline outputs, case-study data, and figure-generation scripts for PISR, a search-free foundation model for symbolic regression that recasts the problem as generation within a pre-trained, contrastively-aligned formula-data manifold. PISR reaches state-of-the-art structural accuracy on an audited real-physics benchmark (797 laws), the Feynman equations, and a cross-domain generalization set, at matched compute and roughly 2.4x faster than search, and uniquely recovers named laws from raw turbulence, astronomy and epidemic data. This record accompanies the paper of the same name (He & Chen).
notes: Data (benchmarks/, baseline_outputs/, case_studies/) and model weights (weights/) are released under CC-BY-4.0; source code under MIT. The 33.6M-expression training corpus is too large for a single record and is available from the authors on request.
